tr: Is your house big? / No, it's small, but it's really nice.
Is your car new? / No, it's really old!
Do you want a coffee? / Yes, thanks.
Hi, Camila! How are you? / Fine, and you?
This is my friend Juliana. / Nice to meet you, Juliana!
Excuse me, can I get by? / Sure, go ahead.
Good morning, Mr. Pedro! How are you? / I'm well, thank you. And you?
What's your name? / My name is Rafael, and yours?
Where are you from, Emma? / I'm from Boston, but I live in Miami.
What do you do? / I'm a nurse. I work in a hospital.
Do you speak English? / I do, but only a little.
Do you have any brothers or sisters? / I do: one sister and two brothers.
This is my husband, Thiago. / Very nice to meet you, Thiago!
Do your parents live here? / No, my parents live in Curitiba.
Excuse me, what time is it? / It's two fifteen.
How much is the açaí? / It's fifteen reais.
What time does the bakery open? / It opens at six in the morning.
What's the total? / It's thirty-two reais.
What day is it today? / Today is Wednesday, the tenth.
What's the weather like there in Recife? / It's hot, as always!
When is your birthday? / My birthday is March 8.
Do you want to go to the movies on Friday? / Sure! What time?
Good evening! A table for two, please. / Of course, this way.
What do you recommend? / The moqueca is great today.
And for you? / I'll have the feijoada.
What are you going to drink? / A still water and a guaraná, please.
Can I help you? / I'm just looking, thanks.
Do you have a bigger size? / Yes, I do. I'll get the large.
Do you take cards? / Yes, we do. Debit or credit?
So, does it fit? / No, it's too big on me.
Do you get up early? / I get up at six, because of work.
Do you live in a house? / No, I live in an apartment downtown.
Who does the dishes at your house? / I do the dishes and my husband cooks.
Excuse me, where is the bank? / It's over there, next to the pharmacy.
Sorry, I'm lost. Where is the square? / It's near here. Go straight ahead and turn right.
Is there a market near here? / Yes, there is. It's on the corner.
A round-trip ticket to Salvador, please. / Sure. That's two hundred reais.
Is this seat free? / Yes, it is. Go ahead and sit down.
Is breakfast included? / Yes, it is. It's from seven to ten.
What's wrong, Pedro? / I have a fever and a headache.
Do you need help, ma'am? / Yes, I do. Can you call a taxi?
Where does it hurt? / It hurts here, on the right side.
Where do you work, Camila? / I work at a hospital in Boston.
Shall we get a coffee at ten? / I can't. I have a meeting at ten.
Teacher, how do you say this in Portuguese? / That's a caneta (a pen).
Shall we go out tonight? / Not today. I'm sleepy.
What's wrong, Juliana? / I'm worried about tomorrow's test.
I got the job! / That's great! Congratulations!
I love cheese bread. / Me too!
What did you do on the weekend? / I went to the beach with my family.
Shall we go to the movies on Saturday? / Let's! Which movie?
A table, please. / Sure. How many people?
The stop is on Augusta Street. / Sorry, what? Can you say that again?
Do you live here? / No, I'm just on vacation.
Are you excited about the trip? / Yes, I'm excited!
Shall we watch this movie today? / I've already seen this movie. Shall we watch another one?
How old are you, Mateus? / I'm twenty.
Where's my phone? / It's over there, on the table.
Here, your key. / Thanks!
Where are you? / I'm almost there! Five minutes.
Everything was delicious. / I'm so glad you liked it!
I finished the report! / Nailed it!
I made the cake myself. / What care you put into it!
Your home is beautiful! / That's kind of you! Come in, make yourself at home.
You speak Portuguese really well! / Oh, not at all! I'm still learning.
That looks great on you. / You think so?
This is my daughter. / How cute!
You look great! / Thanks, you too!
You're beautiful, you know? / Stop, you're making me blush!
Sorry I'm late! / That's OK. You look beautiful today.
What a beautiful smile! / Thanks! You're very kind.
My name is Luana. / What a pretty name!
You look really good in that shirt. / Thanks, I bought it yesterday.
I brought you a coffee. / How sweet! Thanks.
You smell nice. / Thanks! It's a new perfume.
What beautiful eyes! / Thanks, I got them from my mom.
Why are you smiling? / Because you make me laugh.
It's already midnight! / Wow! I love talking with you.
Shall we have dinner on Friday? I'm paying. / Is this a date?
Are you seeing someone? / No, I'm single. And you?
Shall we get a coffee after class? / Let's!
Do you want to go out with me on Saturday? / I'd love to!
Can I get your number? / Sure! It's nine, nine, eight, seven...
I like you, you know? / I like you too.
You're the funniest person I know. / Do you say that to everyone?
Do you want to go out with me on Saturday? / You're really nice, but let's just be friends.
Shall we have dinner tonight? / Not today, but thanks for the invitation.
Rent here is five thousand reais. / Wow! That's expensive!
Can you help me with the suitcase? / Of course!
Careful with the door! / Ouch! Too late.
The party is on Saturday, not Friday. / Oh! I get it.
I lost my passport! / Oh my God! Let's look for it.
Hey! You forgot your phone! / Oh, thanks!
It's way too hot, isn't it? / I know, right!
I'm going to live in Brazil. / Really? How cool!
Thanks for the help! / Oh, come on! It was nothing.
Watch out for the car! / Oh, thanks!
The game ended seven to one. / Wow!
I can't go to the party, I'm sick. / Oh, man, what a shame!
Look, it started to rain! / Whoa! Let's go inside.
The last bus already left. / Uh-oh! Now what?
I won a trip to Rio! / Whoa! Congratulations!
The restaurant is closed. / Huh? But it's Saturday!
The bathroom is over there, on the left. / Oh, I see! Thanks.
The doctor said it's nothing serious. / Thank God!
Achoo! / Bless you!
I think it'll be sunny tomorrow. / I hope so!
You got here just in time! / Phew! I ran a lot.
The bus is late again. / Ugh, what a drag!
Pedro is sick and can't go to the beach. / Poor guy!
Sorry I'm late! / Don't worry about it! I just got here.
There's feijoada for lunch today. / Yay!
This is the view from my apartment. / Wow! How beautiful!
Try this cheese bread. / Mmm… delicious!
Shh! The baby is sleeping. / Sorry!
Exams are over! / Hooray! Vacation!
Uh-oh, I forgot the key. / Again?
